title: New dissector for EXOS internal capture extra header
description:
New dissector: packet-extreme-exeh.c

Starting with EXOS 30, a switch internal header was added to captures
created with "debug packet capture ...".
This header uses its own Ethertype, so it is easy to detect.
Trying to make some sense of the fields.

Ethertype: Add 0xe555 as EXOS internal capture header

@@ -654,6 +654,10 @@ extern "C" {

 #endif
 
+#ifndef ETHERTYPE_EXEH

+#endif
+
 #ifndef ETHERTYPE_FCFT
 #define ETHERTYPE_FCFT			0xFCFC	/* used to transport FC frames+MDS hdr internal to Cisco's MDS switch */
 #endif
